name: Young Conductor
source:
FPF crew.
A young conductor aboard the "Flying Pussyfoot." Has a quirky personality.

[Translated from in-game profile]

[spoiler]In the canon story, the Conductor is actually Claire Stanfield, also known as "Vino" or "The Rail Tracer." In Endings 11 and 41, the Conductor is [b]Tony[/b] (トニー), who had swapped places with Claire prior to the train's departure.[/spoiler]
